source: git archive of committed blobs; working-tree and untracked files are not included
limitations: Installed dependencies, ignored model weights, runtime databases and backups are not bundled.
Secret checks are conservative heuristics, not a complete security audit.
ZIP bytes are reproducible for the same commit and Git implementation; generated_at changes.
Each output file is atomically replaced. A process/OS crash between the two replacements can leave a mismatched pair; verify archive.sha256 before use.
